items.question: How much does a custom billing system cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope and features your business needs. We offer plans ranging from basic business websites to full custom platforms. Contact us for a no-commitment personalized quote.

items.question: What's included in the monthly fee?
items.answer: It covers cloud hosting, dedicated technical support, server maintenance, continuous backups, and system upgrades. Everything required to keep your software running smoothly without surprises.

items.question: How long does a project take to complete?
items.answer: Most projects are live within 3 to 5 weeks. Larger, more complex builds can take anywhere from 1 to 3 months. Either way, you'll have full visibility into our progress from day one.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. We don't disappear after shipping. All our plans include ongoing technical support and maintenance. Your software grows right alongside your business.

items.question: Do you only work with businesses in Nicaragua?
items.answer: Not at all. We work with clients across Latin America and internationally. We're proud to be from Nicaragua, but our software has no borders.
